Sam: CI red on main for serializer snapshots — seeing a bunch of tiny whitespace/quote diffs across multiple prompt tests. Job: https://ci.redwood/infrastructure/1234 :eyes:

ci-bot: Job failed: serial-tests/serializer_snapshots (commit abc1234) — 14 snapshot diffs. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/1234

Miguel: I landed a small change yesterday that trims trailing spaces in JSON attributes (PR #402). Might be a culprit. @Sam can you paste one example diff?

Sam: here's one truncated diff from artifact:
```
- prompt: "Hello world  "
+ prompt: "Hello world"
```

Priya: quick local repro that helped me before:
```
PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests/serialization/test_prompt_snapshot.py::test_prompt_roundtrip -k whitespace -q
# update locally to verify: ./tools/snap_update.sh tests/serialization/test_prompt_snapshot.py::test_prompt_roundtrip
```

Miguel: thanks — I'll run a git bisect between v0.24.1 and HEAD and report back. If it points to my change I'll revert and open a follow-up fix.

Rachel: if bisect points at a vendor/kernel bump (libq/quant kernels), ping eng-runtime immediately — they own that stack.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @Sam — queued job 1235: https://ci.redwood/jobs/1235 :repeat:

Sam: thanks all. I'll watch job 1235 and paste the failing artifact if it still shows diffs. If rerun is clean we'll chalk up transient infra flake. :thumbsup:
